audit.why: Blitzcrank's Q Rocket Grab (1079 range) beats Alistar's short-range kit if pulled from outside Trample's 300 range, since Trample builds his stun stacks and auto-resets his attack for free once he's in melee. Alistar's R Unbreakable Will (120/100/80s CD) clears CC and cuts incoming damage for its duration, so trading into it while it's up just heals him back to full. Headbutt is 14/13/12/11/10s on cooldown, the actual number missing from breakdown.cooldowns.
